aboutGame.title: What is On Thin Ice?
paragraphs: On Thin Ice is a critically acclaimed point-and-click detective mystery and logic puzzle adventure developed by Haiku Games as part of the Adventure Escape Mysteries series. Players follow Detective Kate Gray and Detective Murphy as a routine evening is shattered by a devastating ransomware assault that compromises the entire police department.

Trapped in the middle of a paralyzing winter blizzard, Kate must navigate forensic crime scenes, decipher complex electronic security locks, and expose a lethal cyber extortion syndicate alongside an internal police mole before time runs out.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about On Thin Ice.

items.question: What is On Thin Ice and who developed it?
items.answer: On Thin Ice is a mystery adventure and escape puzzle game developed by Haiku Games as a standalone adventure within the Adventure Escape Mysteries app. Players control Detective Kate Gray as she investigates a department cyberattack and homicide.

items.question: How many chapters are in On Thin Ice?
items.answer: On Thin Ice features 4 full story chapters, guiding players from the compromised police station and Hacksaw's secluded cabin to a corporate high-rise and frozen wilderness.

items.question: What should I do if a puzzle in On Thin Ice gets stuck?
items.answer: If an interactive circuit or sliding puzzle becomes scrambled in On Thin Ice, back out of the puzzle screen to reset the board to its default layout without losing chapter progress.

items.question: Where can I find codes and solutions for On Thin Ice?
items.answer: Our On Thin Ice Wiki provides verified solutions for keypads, safes, terminals, and locker codes across every chapter, including the cabin keypad (40827) and hard drive code (211012).

items.question: Can I play On Thin Ice for free?
items.answer: Yes, On Thin Ice is free to download and play inside Adventure Escape Mysteries on iOS, Android, and PC, with optional stars available for hints.
